stories.title: Teenager charged with 20 offences after thefts from cars across Flintshire and Wrexham
stories.summary: A 16-year-old has been charged with 20 offences, including thefts from cars, reported across Flintshire and Wrexham. North Wales Police said the offences were reported between August and September. The charges include nine counts of theft from a motor vehicle and four counts of vehicle interference. He is also charged with five counts of fraud

stories.title: Airbus launches video series to draw young people into aerospace engineering
stories.summary: Airbus has launched a video series following apprentices and young engineers at its UK sites, as it tries to draw more young people into aerospace jobs. stories.title: Three indoor padel courts are on the way to Deeside Leisure Centre
stories.summary: Three indoor padel courts are to be built at Deeside Leisure Centre, with the courts expected to open in spring 2027. Gwella, the company that runs Flintshire’s leisure centres and libraries, said the courts are being paid for with support from Sport Wales. stories.title: Flintshire Council adopts plan to modernise services after public consultation
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has signed off a three-year plan setting out how it will change the way its services are run, after making changes based on residents’ feedback.
